verdicts.evidence: lines 372, 467-488, 507-547, 565-615, 628-660: Try again, Remove, Invite again, Dismiss, Send invite and Save name all have listeners that call the api or update the list as labelled.

lines 374-393, 397-419, 664-671: names, emails, roles, last active, seat count and notification values all come from api.getTeam(); missing lastActive shows 'Never'; no hardcoded sample or placeholder text.
lines 170-235: one screen, no multi-step flow; no step depends on an earlier screen.
lines 177-191, 212-223: each task is a one or two field single-line form (email plus role, team name); no multi-step task, no long free text.

lines 185-188, 613: invite role preselects Member (the lower privilege) and resets to Member after each invite; no dialog with a default button; Remove is type=button, not triggered by Enter in a form (line 433).
brief lists six occasional tasks with no dominant one; the screen is a settings page of several small tasks (lines 171-234).
lines 171-234: three sections (People with invite and table, Team name, Email notifications) each map to a brief task; seat count supports the invite seat limit; no stat cards, feeds or extra panels.

lines 190, 218, 433, 500-501: in the content view only 'Send invite' has class primary; Save name, Remove, Invite again, Dismiss are plain. 'Try again' (line 167) is the only button in the separate load-error view.
lines 73, 433-434: Remove is a white button with red text (class danger, not primary), type=button so Enter in a form never triggers it, placed alone in the last column away from the role select.

lines 421-423: owner row omits the select and Remove instead of disabling them. Lines 445-446, 470-471, 688: controls are disabled only while that row's own request runs, with 'Saving...' or 'Removing...' beside them. Submit buttons stay enabled.
no title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
lines 159-234 and all script strings: text is headings, labels, statuses and errors about the team; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the request.
lines 502-504: the only notice is the in-row 'X was removed and no longer has access.' placed with its Invite again and Dismiss actions; no other callouts, tips or disclaimers.
lines 159-234: no sentence narrates the screen or its controls. The only guidance is the empty-state line 208 'Invite the first person by email', directly under the invite form.
lines 228-231: heading 'Email notifications' is followed immediately by legend 'Email the team about', which restates the heading in other words above the same four checkboxes.
lines 159, 162, 173, 228 and script messages: plain headings and factual statuses ('Saved', 'Invite sent to ...'); no greeting, slogan or exclamation mark.

lines 167, 190, 218, 433, 500-501: 'Try again', 'Send invite', 'Save name', 'Remove', 'Invite again', 'Dismiss' all start with a specific verb; row buttons sit in the person's row and carry the name in hidden text.

lines 296-302, 342-345, 304, 414-419: role and notification keys are mapped to 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Member', 'Weekly digest' etc, unknown keys are humanized, dates are formatted, null shows 'Never'; no ids or codes shown.

lines 362, 462, 477, 518-520, 554, 577-582, 596, 655, 702: each error names what was not done, the current state and the next step ('Try again', 'Remove someone to free a seat'); e.message and codes are never displayed.
same lines as COPY-011: messages use 'Could not ...' and 'Enter ...'; no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals.
lines 208, 391-392: with zero people the table is hidden and 'No one is on this team yet. Invite the first person by email.' shows directly beneath the invite form, which is the next step.
lines 165-168, 361-365 vs 208, 391-392: a failed load shows 'Could not load team settings.' with Try again in place of the content; an empty team shows the invite prompt. No filters or search exist.

lines 361-365: load failure message plus retry. Lines 590-597, 650-656: invite and rename failures keep the typed value and say Try again. Lines 453-463, 474-478, 695-704: row and checkbox failures revert and state it in place.

lines 161-163, 358: loading text shown at once. Lines 444, 470, 510, 586, 643, 687: 'Saving...', 'Removing...', 'Sending invite...' appear synchronously. Calls are at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel is needed.
lines 170, 351-355, 357-369: #content (including the empty text and seat count) stays hidden until getTeam resolves; only 'Loading team settings...' is visible while waiting.

lines 79, 89, 103: overflow-wrap anywhere on names, emails and messages. Lines 414-419: null lastActive shows 'Never'. Lines 86-97, 136-150: table and stacked rows grow with item count; no fixed-height containers.
lines 712-716: beforeunload asks before leaving when the team name differs from the saved name or the invite email is non-empty; role and notification changes save immediately.
lines 179-181: the only format-bound field is labelled 'Email address', which states the required format before typing; team name only needs to be non-empty (line 638).
lines 177-191, 212-218: every field is required (email, role select with a value always set, team name); there are no optional fields.
lines 561-563, 624-626: input listeners only clear an existing error. Lines 579-584, 638-642: errors are raised only inside the submit handlers.

lines 180-181, 215-216, 334-338, 56: field errors render as text between the label and its input, with aria-invalid and a thicker border; non-field errors (seats, connection) sit just under the form at lines 192-194.
lines 579-597: on client or server rejection the email and role are untouched; the email is cleared only after success (line 612). Lines 650-656: the name input keeps the typed value on failure.

lines 576, 639-640, 652-653: focus moves to the invalid input. Lines 334-338: aria-invalid is set. Lines 181, 216: inputs reference their error with aria-describedby. Non-field errors use role=alert (lines 193, 221).

lines 190, 218: submit buttons are never disabled before completion. Lines 579-580, 638-641: submitting empty shows 'Enter an email address.' or 'Enter a team name.' and focuses the field. aria-disabled only in flight (317-326).

lines 567, 586 and 630, 643: submit handlers return early while the button is busy; the label changes to 'Sending invite...' or 'Saving...' until the response. Same guard on Remove and Invite again (468, 508).

lines 444-446, 470-471, 510-511, 586, 643, 687-688: every control synchronously shows a busy label or 'Saving...' and a dimmed or disabled state before awaiting the api; Dismiss removes the row at once (543).
lines 456-463, 481-486, 606-614, 649, 697-704: success shows 'Saved', the removed notice, the new highlighted row plus 'Invite sent to ...'; every failure path writes an explicit message.

line 614: 'Invite sent to X as Member' reports an email send not otherwise visible. Lines 458, 649, 699: brief inline 'Saved' reports persistence of an auto-saved or unchanged-looking value; no toasts or dialogs.

lines 328-332: only success 'Saved' text auto-clears. Errors (402, 462, 477, 596, 655, 702-703) stay in place until the next attempt; the removed notice with its Invite again action stays until dismissed (502-547).
lines 467-488: Remove runs with no confirmation and replaces the row with a notice offering 'Invite again' (500-536). Role changes apply at once and are reversed with the same select.
brief says a removed person can be invited again; removal is restorable via 'Invite again' (lines 500-536) and an invited person can be removed. No permanent delete, overwrite or payment exists.
no confirm(), dialog element or custom confirmation anywhere in the script; only the browser's unsaved-changes prompt at lines 712-716.

lines 448-463: the select shows the new role while the request runs and is reset to m.role with 'Could not change the role ... is still ...' on failure. Lines 690-704: the checkbox is put back with a message.
no modal dialogs; all work is inline in the page (lines 170-235).
no modal dialogs in the markup or script.
lines 171-209: the People section (invite, roles, removal: four of the six brief tasks) is the first and largest block; Team name and Email notifications follow as smaller sections.
lines 159-171: an h1 'Team settings' is followed directly by the People section; no hero, greeting or intro panel.
lines 174, 390: the only summary number is 'N of 12 seats used', which tells the owner whether another invite is possible (seat limit enforced at lines 584, 595).
the people list has no filter, search, sort or column controls.

all controls are native button, select, input and checkbox elements (lines 181-190, 216-218, 426, 433, 670); busy buttons use aria-disabled so they stay focusable; focus is re-placed after rows change (464, 487, 535, 545-546).
lines 56, 77, 80: red and green are always paired with message text ('Saved', error sentences); invalid inputs get a thicker border plus text; Remove is red but labelled; roles are text.

lines 672, 686-687, 697-700: the notification 'Saving...' and 'Saved' status span has no role or aria-live and no announce() call, so that result is silent. Other messages do use role status/alert (161, 193-194, 220-221, 237, 400).
nothing expands or collapses; the only choosers are native select elements (lines 185, 426).

lines 128-151: under 640px forms become one column, controls get 44px height, table rows become stacked grids with 'Role' and 'Last active:' labels, the removed notice wraps; long text uses overflow-wrap anywhere; no dialogs.
